background_notes.fact: For a K-linear subspace W of a K-vector space, the linear endomorphisms A satisfying A(W) subset W contain the identity and are closed under composition, K-scalar multiplication and finite sums. In particular, stability under A implies stability under A^r for every natural r.

grounds.reason: W is a K-linear subspace of V_K.
L1 assumes stability under x_K,y_K,h_K; the other operators are scalar compositions by N004.
All T_ij and the induced operators are K-linear endomorphisms with the displayed factorization.

background_notes.justification: For w in W, Bw lies in W and then A(Bw) lies in W whenever A and B preserve W. Subspace closure places a A(w) and finite sums of such vectors in W. The identity preserves W. Induction starting from the identity proves closure under each nonnegative power. These facts justify exactly the operations used in S002.

background_notes.fact: In the field K of characteristic prime p, if 0<=r<=lambda<p, the image of r! in K is nonzero and has a multiplicative inverse.

background_notes.justification: Every integer t between 1 and r is strictly between 0 and p, so its image in a field of characteristic p is nonzero. Their finite product is nonzero since a field has no zero divisors. For r=0 the product is 1. Each resulting nonzero field element is invertible.

background_notes.fact: For L_K=(Zx+Zy+Zh) tensor_Z K, the elements x tensor 1, y tensor 1, h tensor 1 span L_K over K. For the K-linear representation rho, a K-linear subspace is an L_K-submodule exactly when it is invariant under x_K,y_K,h_K.

grounds.reason: D014 gives exactly this tensor construction of L_K.
rho is K-linear with the stated generator action; its guards H005 and N002 are direct inputs.

background_notes.justification: Every tensor is a finite sum of pure tensors. For a,b,d in Z, balancing and additivity express (a x+b y+d h) tensor c as (a c)(x tensor 1)+(b c)(y tensor 1)+(d c)(h tensor 1), where integer coefficients are mapped into K. Thus every rho(z) is a K-linear combination of the three generator operators and preserves W if those operators do. Conversely, stability under all rho(z) includes these three. This is precisely the defining stability condition for a submodule.
